FDA · INOOCT 30, 2026

FDA grants accelerated approval to Inovio’s Voceryq.

The agency approved the first U.S. plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy for adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis. FDA names Inovio Pharmaceuticals as the approval recipient; Inovio’s SEC filing confirms Nasdaq ticker INO.

FDA action ↗ Ticker evidence ↗
DOJ / EEOC · CARTOCT 20, 2026

Instacart reaches $5 million federal employment settlement.

DOJ and EEOC announced a fund of up to $4 million for affected applicants plus a $1 million civil penalty. Maplebear’s SEC filing confirms Instacart and Nasdaq ticker CART.

DOJ release ↗ Ticker evidence ↗
DOJ · GOOGL / GOOGSEP 16, 2026

Court imposes Google ad-tech interoperability and monitoring remedies.

DOJ says the order requires integrations with rival tools, data sharing, anti-discrimination safeguards, and six years of oversight. Alphabet’s SEC filing confirms GOOGL and GOOG.
